scripts.test:packaged:existing: node scripts/smoke-document-registration.mjs && node scripts/smoke-linked-sources.mjs --packaged && node scripts/smoke-desktop.mjs --packaged && node scripts/smoke-draft.mjs --packaged && node scripts/smoke-mcp.mjs --packaged && node scripts/smoke-mcp-context.mjs --packaged --visible
